reserveReview.rationale: The current issuer metrics payload includes byAsset.reusd and byAsset.reusde on-chain numerators, but publishes offchain_capital as a protocol aggregate. It does not supply the attributable off-chain denominator and quantified tranche waterfall needed to turn these numerators into reUSD backing percentages. The measured protocol-pooled composition is retained as unlinked context. Every token link is withheld, including sUSDe (NC-116), so a reviewed overlay cannot turn protocol percentages into tranche dependencies. On 2026-10-03 only sUSDS liquidity metadata was newly researched: Sky documents fee-free ERC-4626 withdrawal to USDS at any time with no lockup, supporting the conservative one-day realization class, not guaranteed fiat settlement. No weights, composition clock or tranche attribution were refreshed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Protocol-pooled Re Metrics embedded payload captured 2026-09-30, normalized without rounding. These percentages describe protocol holdings, not attributable reUSD tranche backing.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full protocol-pooled composition has unresolved reUSD attribution. Token-specific on-chain numerators alone do not establish an off-chain denominator or tranche loss allocation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Fireblocks provides the disclosed MPC custody infrastructure; Resilience Inv SPC holds the separate reUSD and reUSDe note portfolios. No current custody shares or named Section 114 trust bank were established. Segregated trust accounts protect ceding insurers, while token holders have no direct legal claim to those assets and instead have indirect exposure through unsecured, limited-recourse principal-at-risk notes. Token-holder bankruptcy remoteness, full-stack segregation and rehypothecation restrictions remain unverified.
